def client(host=RESTAPI_SERVER_HOST, port=RESTAPI_SERVER_PORT):
    """
    REST-JSON API client
    """
    addr = "http://%s:%d" % (host, port)
    logger.info("Starting REST-JSON API client to '%s'..." % addr)

    import requests

    # Simple client implementation using requests
    try:
        response = requests.post(f'http://{host}:{port}/task/new')
        taskid = response.json().get('taskid')
        logger.info(f'Task ID: {taskid}')
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f'Error: {e}')
        return

    logger.info("Use the following commands to interact with the API:")
    print(f"\n\t$ curl http://{host}:{port}/scan/$taskid/start")
    print(f"\t$ curl http://{host}:{port}/scan/$taskid/data")
    print(f"\t$ curl http://{host}:{port}/scan/$taskid/log\n")
